text:
maya: quick note from an oncall run this morning — saw duplicate attempts when the ingress and the upstream sidecar both started hedging around the same time. we should tighten the contract so only one system is the source of truth for hedging decisions.

sam: saw the same in canary a couple weeks ago. duplicates cost tokens and make SLOs noisy. ~0.5% of requests doubled. :face_with_thermometer: we should quantify cost delta.

oliver: high-level take: ingress should own global hedging decisions and issue a signed lease token that downstreams can optionally consume to do a bounded local hedge. downstreams must not initiate hedges without the token.

alix: curious about local cache or sidecar cases where upstream can complete faster than re-routing to another backend. if ingress forbids local hedging we might lose cheap wins.

maya: agree — that's why the token should include a small window and flags: allows_local=true, window_ms=80, idempotency_required=true. downstreams can act only if token permits.

li: what about non-idempotent POSTs? we can't let sidecars retry blindly. proposal: add an explicit header "x-rw-idempotency-hint: safe|unsafe|unknown". only safe allowed for local hedges by default.

nina: we'll need telemetry to separate hedge-origin attribution. add labels hedge_origin={ingress,downstream,client} and hedge_reason. also debug header to trace per-request: "x-rw-hedge-trace: ingress=hedged,downstream=skipped".

sam: implementation tradeoff: tokens signed with HMAC or KMS-signed? HMAC is cheap but needs rotation; KMS calls could add latency. maybe stateless HMAC tokens with short expiry (100-200ms) and allow caches for validation for 5-10s.

hedgebot: checklist: update edge proto, add header budget, add telemetry labels, add sdk examples.

oliver: another piece: where do we track hedge budget? easiest is ingress owns a per-route budget (fraction or rps). downstreams consume that budget by presenting the lease token. ingress can issue lease tokens with embedded quota. no extra RPC needed.

alix: embedding quota in token is nice but means ingress can run out-of-sync if it issues many tokens quickly. must include expiry and usage window. tokens should be HMACed to avoid state in ingress.

li: validating HMAC per-request is CPU cost for high-throughput services. suggestion: only validate for requests where downstream attempts a local hedge (rare), otherwise ignore. plus use a short in-memory cache for token validations.

maya: abort/cancel semantics need to be explicit. if client cancels and ingress has hedged while a secondary downstream hedge is inflight, ingress cancellation should propagate and downstreams must abort their secondaries. recommend header "x-rw-hedge-session: <uuid>" to correlate.

nina: also define partial-response behavior: if downstream returns partial but then cancels, how does ingress choose which result to return? RFC should include sequence diagrams for races.

sam: performance experiment: i'll simulate issuing tokens and HMAC validation on downstream at scale to measure CPU and latency delta.

oliver: security note: HMAC secret rotation and limiting token lifetime are important. add key-rotation plan to RFC.

maya: draft config snippet for RFC: 

```yaml
edge.hedging:
  enabled: true
  mode: ingress-first # ingress owns global decision
  global_budget_fraction: 0.03
  token_expiry_ms: 120
  local_window_ms: 80
  require_idempotency_hint_for_local_hedge: true
```

li: I'll draft idempotency-hint semantics and default fallbacks for unknown/unsafe.

alix: i'll write upstream-sidecar guidance for honoring tokens and abort semantics.

nina: i'll mock telemetry dashboards and include cost comparison (tokens consumed & extra downstream CPU).

sam: ping me when draft exists, will run canary load test and perf bench.

maya: plan: i'll assemble a short RFC with headers, token grammar, sequence diagrams, rollout plan (opt-in route flag -> gradual default -> instrumented switch). owners: maya (draft), sam (perf), oliver (upstream), li (safety), nina (telemetry), alix (sidecars). target RFC by next Wednesday.

hedgebot: reminder: add unit tests for token parsing, validation cache, and abort propagation.

maya: thanks everyone. ending thread — will post draft link when ready.
